- Novalion is a strategic prospect in the MedTech corridor; expected ARR if we convert after pilot is $360k ARR within 12 months.
- They need a pilot start week of Dec 7; board packet is due Mon 12/7 (hence urgency).

Why I’m escalating: The cap + waiver is outside our standard pilot packaging (we usually allow 1.5M token-soft caps). The delta increases our exposure on burst usage and could set precedent for later pilots in healthcare. The revenue tradeoff is reasonable given strategic value, but this needs VP/CFO signoff as a commercial exception.

Please see the attached SOW (Novalion_SOW_v3.pdf) and an October usage sample (usage_report_oct.csv). Questions I expect: impact to ARPA, break-even timeline, and whether we require a minimum committed spend in month 2 to guard against runaway bursts.

- Ben: confirm invoicing flow and whether the credit should be applied as a deferred revenue contra or immediate invoice credit.

Quoted message below for context.

Thanks — appreciate the quick eyes.
Kim

Kim / team — reviewed with finance and growth. Decision: approve the pilot concessions with the following conditional signoff (CFO verbal ok):

1) Approve one-time onboarding credit at 40% of month-1 estimated consumption (apply as invoice credit).
2) Approve temporary overage waiver months 1–3 capped at 2.5M tokens/month. Any usage above the cap is billable immediately.
3) Require a minimum committed usage in month 2 equal to 60% of projected month-1 tokens; if Novalion declines this minimum, the waiver will drop to a 1.5M token cap (fallback).
4) All pilot usage must be instrumented to our telemetry standard (tracing + token export) and Novalion must provide weekly snapshots. Failure to provide data voids waiver.
5) Apply a one-time marketing credit of $5k in addition to the credit above (to be used in co-marketing activities and not applied to invoice balance).

Please record these conditions in the SOW and send the final to Elena. Ben — proceed with invoice credit mechanics as immediate credit (not deferred). Jordan — please add the condition language into the SOW and loop legal if they attempt to change the waiver language.
